scope: Exploratory native probe on one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN (V21): certificate_create/assign (PlcCommunicationCertificate, there and back)/delete applied with exact readback; umac_role_set create/grant/assign/unassign/revoke applied; vci_workspace_create/delete applied; instance_lookup found the single-instance DB and both call-site sources; webserver_page_set refused WebServerNotActivated on a CPU with web serving off.
limitations: Exploratory probe of one scratch project and one CPU: not feature qualification, no reopen/recovery/interruption gates beyond each apply's own readback.
Web page settings were only probed for their refusal; no change kind activates web serving.
Certificate validity is converted to local wall-clock time for TIA; times inside a DST fall-back hour are ambiguous.
